ruleBlocks.text: В пассиве фокус на объекте/результате, а не на деятеле. Схема из картинки: Active = Mouse ate cheese, Passive = Cheese was eaten (by mouse).

ruleBlocks.title: Главная формула
lines: Passive = be + V3 (past participle)
Объект из Active становится подлежащим в Passive
Исполнитель добавляется через by только если он реально важен

ruleBlocks.caption: Базовые формы (как на шпаргалке)
rows: The room is cleaned every day.
The project will be finished soon.
The task must be done today.
The app has been downloaded a lot.
By 2010 the plan had been approved.
The work will have been completed by Friday.

ruleBlocks.caption: Разница предлогов
rows: The book was written by J.K. Rowling.
The letter was written with a pen.

ruleBlocks.title: Когда by обычно не нужен
lines: исполнитель неизвестен: My bike was stolen.
исполнитель очевиден и неважен: The road was closed at night.
официальный стиль/инструкции/новости: The report will be sent tomorrow.

ruleBlocks.caption: 4 шага преобразования
rows: People clean the office every day.
Добавляем V3 и при необходимости by-agent
The office is cleaned every day (by staff).

items.en: Active: They will deliver our furniture on Thursday.
items.ru: Passive: Our new furniture will be delivered on Thursday.

items.en: Active: People use the internet worldwide.
items.ru: Passive: The internet is used worldwide.

items.en: Active: They inspired the book with childhood memories.
items.ru: Passive: The book was inspired by childhood memories.

items.en: Active: Someone has stolen my phone.
items.ru: Passive: My phone has been stolen.

ruleBlocks.title: Ловушка 1: не все глаголы делают пассив
lines: intransitive (без прямого объекта) обычно не пассивятся: happen, appear, rain
Правильно: Small cracks appeared. (не were appeared)
Правильно: It rains a lot in spring. (не is rained)
Правильно: The best thing that has ever happened to me. (не was happened)

ruleBlocks.title: Ловушка 2: смотри на смысл, а не на by в предложении
lines: Some influencers make thousands of pounds... -> active, потому что есть субъект-деятель
By the age of 13, Fred had joined a troupe. -> active (сам присоединился)
In the 1990s, Sean started a company. -> active
The internet is used by billions... -> passive (над интернетом совершают действие)

ruleBlocks.title: Ловушка 3: participle как состояние (похоже на passive)
lines: be involved in, be interested in, be born, be located, be called
Molly is involved with a charity.
I was born in Belarus.
The book is called 'The Invisible Man'.

ruleBlocks.caption: Частые пассивные/пассивоподобные паттерны
rows: The film is called 'Stand By Me'.
Her eyes were filled with tears.
The meeting will be held at 5.
A man was injured in the accident.
Two cars were involved in the crash.
I was trapped in the lift.

ruleBlocks.title: Короткий чек перед ответом
lines: 1) Кто в фокусе: исполнитель или объект?
2) Есть ли у глагола прямой объект (можно ли вообще сделать passive)?
3) Какое время по маркерам: now/usually, yesterday, by..., since..., next...?
4) Для passive выбери правильную форму be и обязательно V3

items.prompt: The road was closed at night.
items.explain: Важен факт закрытия дороги, не кто закрыл.

items.prompt: The report will be checked tomorrow.
options: официальный стиль и фокус на действии
items.explain: Деловой/официальный стиль часто использует passive.

items.prompt: English is spoken in many countries.
items.explain: Факт в Present Simple Passive.

items.prompt: My bike was stolen.
items.explain: Мы не знаем или не называем, кто украл.

items.prompt: The museum is visited by thousands of tourists.
items.explain: В центре внимания музей как объект действия.

items.prompt: The invitations were sent yesterday.
items.explain: Подчеркивается факт отправки приглашений.

items.prompt: The room ____ (clean) every day.
items.explain: Present Simple Passive: is + V3.

items.prompt: The emails ____ (send) this morning.
items.explain: Past Simple Passive: were + V3.

items.prompt: The project ____ (finish) next week.
items.explain: Future Simple Passive: will be + V3.

items.prompt: People speak Spanish here. -> Spanish ____ here.
items.explain: Объект Spanish становится подлежащим: is spoken.

items.prompt: They built the bridge in 2010. -> The bridge ____ in 2010.
items.explain: Past Simple Passive: was built.

items.prompt: The task will finished tomorrow.
accepted: The task will be finished tomorrow
The task will be finished tomorrow.
items.explain: В Future Passive нужен вспомогательный be: will be finished.

items.prompt: The old building ____ (pull down).
items.explain: Modal passive: should + be + V3.

items.prompt: The internet ____ (use) by billions of people.
items.explain: Present Simple Passive: is used.

items.prompt: I tried the door and ... it unlocked.
items.explain: Нужно активное found: I found it unlocked.

items.prompt: Our new furniture ... on Thursday.
items.explain: Будущее + объект в фокусе -> will be delivered.

items.prompt: Instagram is a platform that ... digital marketing.
items.explain: Здесь актив: платформа сама изменила сферу -> has revolutionised.

items.prompt: Molly ... with a charity that helps animals.
items.explain: Устойчивый паттерн состояния: be involved with/in.

items.prompt: That's the best thing that ... to me.
items.explain: happen не пассивится; нужен актив Present Perfect: has happened.

items.prompt: It ... that the old building should be pulled down.
items.explain: Безличная конструкция в пассиве: It was decided that...

items.prompt: Small cracks ... in the wall after the earthquake.
items.explain: appear - непереходный глагол, пассив невозможен.

items.prompt: In spring it ... a lot, but rainfall is light.
items.explain: Общий факт -> Present Simple active: rains.

items.prompt: The internet is a global system that ... by billions of people worldwide.
items.explain: Над интернетом выполняют действие -> is used.

items.prompt: Before the invention of the wheel, humans ... in how much they could transport over land.
items.explain: Состояние в прошлом, вызванное внешним фактором -> were limited.

items.prompt: By the age of 13, Fred ... a travelling dance-theatre troupe.
items.explain: Fred сам выполнил действие -> active Past Perfect.

items.prompt: In the 1990s, Sean ... a company to produce themed clothing.
items.explain: Есть деятель Sean -> active Past Simple.

items.prompt: It ... that about 40 percent of the world's population use social media.
items.explain: Типичная безличная научная конструкция: It is estimated that...

items.prompt: The Facebook website ... in 2004 and now it ... by billions per month.
items.explain: 1) запуск - объект в фокусе (past passive), 2) использование сейчас (present passive).

items.prompt: Ancient mariners ... the stars for navigation, but this method ... on cloudy nights.
items.explain: Обе части активные: used, did not work.

items.prompt: Canva ... a free-to-use design tool. It can ... to create posters.
items.explain: 1) is - факт, 2) can be used - modal passive.
